batch_size_benchmark.bottleneck_diagnosis: GPU/CPU collation & post-processing bound. Frame decoding is 577+ fps and not the bottleneck. Larger batches introduce CPU tensor collation and heatmap post-processing contention, degrading throughput.

batch_size_8.decision: SELECTED (Optimal throughput and minimal memory footprint)

batch_size_32.decision: REJECTED (36% slower than batch size 8; would increase 9-day run to 14 days)
